rationale.complexity: 边防、海权、工艺与形成条件交错。
rationale.dark_story: 强硬王权与复仇色彩；不把普通战争当成暴行。
rationale.difficulty: 需撑过强敌并取得复国条件，未实机测评。
rationale.diplomacy: 停战与盟友有价值，但不是主轴。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 乌钢工艺有特色但并非魔奇主线。
rationale.narrative_density: 黑霜家族、灰潮和复国连成故事。
rationale.tall_play: 工业重要但任务终点依赖领土。
rationale.trade_economy: 黑松航运与乌钢投入需要财政。
rationale.warfare: 北方对外战争和复国为主轴。

identity.formation_scope: 满足格鲁迪亚形成决议后可改为Z34黑卡斯塔诺，原Z15继续其任务

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 越过乌尔维克斯滕的山脉和山谷，是一个广阔的、令人生畏的被称为巨人之泪的泥泞之地。这些土地严酷无情，长期以来除了最顽强的个体外，无人居住。但现在巨人之泪里住着兽人，卑鄙的生物。乌尔维克斯滕必须保卫这条边界线。
description.text_en: Past the mountains and vales of Urviksten lies an expansive, forbidding mireland known as the Giants Tears. These lands are harsh and unforgiving, long being a land unpopulated except for the hardiest of individuals. But now the Giant's Tears are inhabited by orcs, vile creatures. Urviksten must secure this frontier against them.

effects.display: 取得时脚本：取得理念时执行脚本（见下方原文）

description.text: 卡斯坦·乌木寒霜，东坎诺和卡斯塔诺的传奇征服者，出生并成长于乌尔维克斯滕。当他带着他的追随者和著名的黑龙离开这片土地时，他的王朝仍在乌尔维克斯滕延续。他死后，他的一个儿子乌尔维克带着自己的军队回到乌尔维克斯滕，重新夺回了家园。从那时起，乌尔维克斯滕一直保留着卡斯坦·乌木寒霜军队的严格和纪律严明的军事战术。
description.text_en: Castan Ebonfrost, legendary conqueror of Escann, conquerer of Castanor, was born and raised in Urviksten. While he left this land with his followers and the famous black dragon, his dynasty lives on in Urviksten. After his demise, one of Castanor's sons, Urvik, returned to Urviksten with an army of his own to retake the homeland. Since then Urviksten has retained the strict and disciplined army tactics of Castan Ebonfrost's army.

name.text: 卡斯坦·乌木寒霜的遗产

description.text: 虽然乌尔维克斯滕的峡湾寒冷、无情、荒凉，但它们拥有丰富的自然资源，尤其是优质木材。黑霜山脉的黑松有着独特的黑色树干，坚硬如铁，但只要有适当的技术，它们很容易被砍倒。它们不仅对舰船有用，由于它们增加了韧性，在提高产量方面也非常出色。
description.text_en: While the fjords of Urviksten are cold, unforgiving and bleak, they are full of natural resources, especially prime timber. Unique with their black trunks, the Black Pines of the Black Frost Mountains are hard as iron, although with the right technique can easily be felled. Not only useful for ships, they are also excellent for improving production due to their increased toughness.

description.text: 在南方，在巨人之泪和卡斯塔诺，庞大的兽人渣滓大军在这片土地上横行霸道。虽然他们可能摧毁了南方古老而强大的土地，但卡斯坦·乌木寒霜的子孙们有足够的力量清除这些污物。你只需要在需要的地方用力，在其他地方用力。
description.text_en: To the south, in the Giants Tears and in Castanor, vast hordes of orcish scum rampage across the lands. While they may have destroyed the ancient and powerful lands to the south, the descendants of Castan Ebonfrost are more than powerful enough to remove these filth. You need only apply force where needed, and shove elsewhere.

description.text: 旗帜在乌尔维克斯滕的军队上方飘扬，白如新雪，上面装饰着卡斯坦·乌木寒霜的黑龙。乌尔维克斯滕拥有一支庞大的军队，它更像是一支拥有国家的军队，而不是一个拥有军队的国家。乌尔维斯滕的经济和政治都使军队尽可能的高效，庞大和致命。
description.text_en: Banners waving in the wind, as pale as fresh snow, emblazoned with the black dragon of Castan Ebonfrost, wave above the armies of Urviksten. Possessing a vast military, Urviksten is more of a military with a state attached than a state with an army. The economy and politics of Urviksten are all focused to make the army as efficient, and numerous, as possible.

description.text: 在过去，乌尔维克斯滕和黑卡斯塔诺的珍宝——「乌钢军械库」，供应着由乌钢制成的高质量武器和盔甲，是一个巨大的铸造厂、匠人聚落和军械库，乌钢这种黑色自然合金金属在乌尔维克斯滕随处可见。
description.text_en: The prize of Urviksten, and of Castanor in the past, the Ebonsteel Armory is a vast foundry, blacksmith and armory supplying high quality weapons and armor made of Ebonsteel, a dark naturally alloyed metal found throughout Urviksten.

description.text: 卡斯坦·乌木寒霜征服了东坎诺，卡斯塔诺，甚至维特斯克。这些土地都属于乌尔维克斯滕，卡斯塔诺的继承人。黑龙旗帜将再次从银池飘扬到月神之首海！
description.text_en: Castan Ebonfrost conquered Escann, Castanor and even Vertesk. All these lands rightfully belong to Urviksten, heirs to Castanor. The Black Dragon Banner will wave from the Silvermere to the Dameshead Sea once more!

description.text:
卡斯坦·乌木寒霜是卡斯塔诺的传奇征服者，来自乌尔维克斯滕寒冷的土地。年轻时，他是一个出身低微的掠夺者，经过多年的掠夺而晋升。他的事迹传遍了整个国家，在865年，他被授予永冻边区的统治权，这是卡斯塔诺的计谋。

一年后，他率领军队横扫卡斯塔诺，杀死卡斯坦四十八世，并加冕为卡斯塔诺的新卡斯坦。他洗劫了审判山上的卡斯特罗斯神殿，这个神殿负责守卫和管理决定卡斯塔诺领袖的试炼。之后，唯一被允许参加试炼的人是由乌木卫队维护的乌木寒霜王朝的后裔。
description.text_en:
Castan Ebonfrost was the legendary conqueror of Castanor, hailing from the cold lands of Urviksten. In his youth he was a lowborn Reaver who rose the ranks after many years of raiding. Word of his exploits spread across the lands, and in 865 he was awarded the dominion of Vrorenmarch as a ploy by Castanor.

A year later he smashed through Castanor with his armies and killed Castan XLVIII, and crowned himself as the new Castan of Castanor. He did so by sacking the temple of Castellos on the Trialmount, which guards and administers the trials which decide the leader of Castanor, known as Castan. Afterwards, the only individuals allowed to take the trials were descendents of the Ebonfrost dynasty, maintained by the Ebon Guard.

description.text: 乌木卫队是黑卡斯塔诺的精锐军事力量，只对卡斯坦·乌木寒霜及其继任者负责。他们装备着乌钢盔甲和武器，让全世界都感到恐惧。乌木卫队主要由强壮的格鲁迪亚人组成，尽管一些当地的东坎诺人被授予了加入守卫队的特权。乌木卫队以守卫审判山而闻名，也曾参与过只需要精英中的精英的军事行动。
description.text_en: The Ebon Guard were the elite military force of Black Castanor, answering only to Castan Ebonfrost and his successors. Outfitted with Ebonsteel armor and weaponry, they were feared throughout the world. The Ebon Guard was primarily made up of strong Gerudians of Ebonmarck, although some of the native Escanni that proved worthy were given the privilege of joining the Guard. Most famous for guarding the Trialmount, the Ebon Guard also served in military maneuvers that required only the best of the best.

description.text: 一个传奇的神器，乌木寒霜之拳是一个注入了魔像力量的魔法手套。它以他的爆炸性的愤怒而闻名，卡斯坦·乌木寒霜戴着这个手套粉碎桌子，以表明他的观点，或通过手套击败他的对手更清楚地表明他的观点。
description.text_en: A legendary artifact, Ebonfrost's Fist was a magical gauntlet infused with the strength of golems. Famous for his explosive anger, Castan Ebonfrost wore this gauntlet to smash tables to make his point clear, or to make his point even more clear by beating his opposition into submission.

description.text: 黑卡斯塔诺征服了四面八方，从蛇脊山脉到月神之首海上的维特斯克。自从卡斯塔诺的辉煌时代以来，还没有哪个帝国拥有过这样的权柄。虽然这些土地在黑卡斯塔诺因术士王之战而分崩离析后误入歧途，但没有人能否认我们帝国的古老疆界。随着黑卡斯塔诺的恢复，我们应该利用这些广泛的宣称来恢复我们在东坎诺之外的领土！
description.text_en: Black Castanor conquered far and wide, from the Serpentspine Mountains to Vertesk on the Dameshead Sea. No empire had boasted such a claim since the glory days of old Castanor. Although these lands have gone astray after the disintegration of Black Castanor following the War of the Sorcerer-King, none can deny the ancient bounds of our empire. With Black Castanor restored, we should utilize these extensive claims to restore our realm beyond Escann!

description.text: 黑卡斯塔诺最重要的创新之一，乌钢为黑卡斯塔诺对土地的广泛征服和平定铺平了道路。乌尔维克斯滕的黑霜山脉发现了一种特殊的类钢黑色合金，比已经很稀有的钢更轻、更强，但也可以用一种特殊的金属和矿物组合来制造。随着这门艺术的重生，黑卡斯塔诺的军队将再次征服这片拥有精良钢铁的土地。
description.text_en: One of the most important innovations of Black Castanor, Ebonsteel paved the way for the extensive conquest and pacification of lands by Black Castanor. A special steel-like black alloy, lighter and stronger than already-rare steel, can be found in the Black Frost mountains of Urviksten, but can also be created with a special combination of metals and minerals. With this art reborn, the armies of Black Castanor will once more conquer the lands bearing this superior steel.

description.text: 黑卡斯塔诺是由掠夺者建立的，无论是在过去还是在王国的新复辟时期。这些传奇的战士组成了征服这片土地的第一代士兵，为了保持这一优势，卡斯坦·乌木寒霜建立了黑色掠夺者学院。这所学院以格鲁迪亚的方式训练军官战争的艺术，这对东坎诺来说是独特和奇怪的。虽然它在术士王之战结束时被所谓的自由领域联盟洗劫和夷为平地，但我们已经重建了这个宏伟的机构以确保我们的军事遗产永远不会丢失！
description.text_en: Black Castanor was founded by Reavers, both in the past and in the new restoration of the realm. These legendary warriors formed the first generation of soldiers that conquered the land, and in order to preserve this advantage Castan Ebonfrost established the Black Reaver Academy. This Academy trained the officers of the realm in the art of war, in the Gerudian way that is unique and strange to the Escanni. Although it was ransacked and razed by the League of so-called Free Realms at the end of the War of the Sorcerer-King, we have rebuilt this magnificent institution to ensure that our martial heritage may never be lost!

description.text: 战争的基本要素之一是持续不断的人力供应。在乌木寒霜时期，卡斯塔诺被叛国的领主们所困扰，他们在公开和秘密中阻挠我们的合法统治。即使过了几个世纪，即使在东坎诺被绿潮摧毁之后，这片土地上仍然有叛徒。为了制服那些伪装者，重新夺回我们合法的土地，必须通过一项法案，通过强制征兵来确保我们的储备永远充足。领主和贵族们再也不能阻碍我们的努力了。
description.text_en: One of the staples of warfare is a constant supply of manpower. Castanor in the days of the Ebonfrost were plagued by treasonous lords who thwarted our rightful rule both openly and behind closed doors. Even centuries later, even after the destruction of the Escanni by the Greentide, the land still harbors traitors. In order to subdue the pretenders and retake our rightful lands, an act must be passed to make sure that our reserves are always full by enforcing conscription. The lords and nobility will no longer be able to hamper our efforts any more.

player_overview.avoid_if: 想轻松种田或不愿应对强邻与形成条件的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先守住边境并寻找突破，再发展港口、工业和军力，最后争取旧帝国继承权。
player_overview.overview: 乌尔维克斯滕是1444年仍在坚守的黑霜王朝北方领地。你要同时面对兽人边防、北方邻国和海权竞争，经营黑松舰队与有条件的乌钢工艺，逐步为重建黑卡斯塔诺取得领土和资格。它是艰难的王朝复国战，而非开局强国。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢北方硬仗、王朝复国和海陆并举的玩家。
signature_features: 卡尔二世和黑霜王朝的复兴故事。
黑松海权与乌钢工艺构成军备主线。
满足严格条件后可形成黑卡斯塔诺并延续任务。
player_overview.tagline: 从北境残局复兴黑霜王朝，最终争取黑卡斯塔诺之名。

reasons: 黑松舰队与乌钢工业有辨识度
warnings: 乌钢部分内容受DLC和条件限制

positive_indicators: 发展舰队和军备保护边疆
values.rationale: 抵御袭扰与保护本国是具体公共目标；卡尔的残酷性格、强硬王权和复仇语境限制高分。战争和君主制本身不扣分，后续占领区政策未全量核验。
red_flags: 复仇与集中王权可能压过居民利益
